svg.title: Namikaze — The Shearing Sky. Draft 4 / Wind classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 wording; values unchanged).
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Wind at the Back forks into Razor Crosswind then Cleaving Cyclone, or Searing Squall then Fanning the Flames. Eye of the Storm forks into Windward Guard then Heart of the Tempest, or Smothering Headwind then Dead Calm. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Wind jutsu.

enemy Decrease Damage Given on Wind Step's circle","rationale":"Five of the eight supported rows are offensive: three Wind Damage rows (Cutting Tempest 45, Tempest Shroud 40, Wind Step 40 at jutsu level 25) and two self Increase Damage Given rows (Cutting Tempest 35%, Wind-only; hidden Soaring Fujin 21.25%), over a 15% + 0.15/level Wind Increase Damage Given passive, so offense is primary with a raw-EP Damage route and a buff-weighted Foundation. Tempest Shroud carries three rows on one A-rank cast; its 35% Afterburn is one debuff row whose value lands on every later non-pierce hit a debuffed target takes, so pressure is secondary with one route. Control is two element-less 30% rows, self Decrease Damage Taken on Tempest Shroud and enemy Decrease Damage Given on Wind Step's ground circle, each on the single-row +10% route; move and pool-cost rows are unsupported. Calm"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Reference reuse: topology and most flats copy Taiyo Kami nearly verbatim (Eye of the Storm = Sunward Oath +2%/+2%; Damage +2/+3; Afterburn +3%/+7%; DDT +3%/+5%; DDG Hidden Art +3%). Departures: no Increase Damage Taken row exists, so Wind at the Back is a single-tag +3% IDG root, the burn and shield capstones carry +2% IDG (not +3% IDT/IDG) and Dead Calm's secondary is +1 Damage, not +5% IDT. The shape fits: the kit has the same four roles (Wind hits, downstream burn, self shield, enemy suppression).","Flats scale by coverage. Damage reaches three Wind rows (45/40/40) on the default Hidden +2 / Advanced +3 route (+5). Afterburn is one downstream row: 3% + 7% = +10% (35 \u2192 45%). Decrease Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Given are one element-less row each on the single-row 2/3/5 route (+10%: 30 \u2192 40%). Increase Damage Given reaches two rows, one hidden: +3% Foundation plus +2% capstone secondaries, max +5%. RUL-2026-10-03-005 review: every route already sits on its band and inside the ceilings, so no value changed.","Capstone secondaries never out-bid a Hidden Art on the same tag: Fanning the Flames and Heart of the Tempest add +2% Increase Damage Given (no Hidden Art carries it); Dead Calm adds +1 Damage under Razor Crosswind's +2. Row-weighted node values (\u03a3 flat \u00d7 rows): Foundations 6/4, Hidden Arts 6/3/3/3, Advanced Arts 9/11/9/8; full builds span 16\u201326 (raw 11\u201319) against Taiyo Kami's 16\u201331 (raw 12\u201324) on nine rows. Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +5, IDG +5%, Afterburn +10%, DDT +10%, DDG +10%; not jointly attainable.","Matching (tags.ts getEfficiencyRatio): Cutting Tempest's buff row lists Wind with no stat or general filter, so it reaches Wind hits only (kit Damage rows, Wind normal jutsu), not element-less hits. Soaring Fujin's row (Wind, Highest stat, four general types) reaches nearly every hit. Shroud's DDT and Afterburn rows and Wind Step's DDG row are element-less with all four stat types, so they cover every non-pierce hit. Kit buffs and debuffs multiply each matching hit in turn (\u00a73b); the bloodline-sourced Wind passive applies last.","Timing (\u00a73b): each percentage row is live in the two rounds after its cast round, never in it, so Cutting Tempest's buff never helps its own hit or a same-round action and CD 6 keeps it off its own recasts; it lifts the Shroud and Wind Step hits that follow. Tempest Shroud (A, 60 AP, CD 7, OTHER_USER circle, range 4) carries Damage, shield and Afterburn. Wind Step (D, 60 AP, CD 7, EMPTY_GROUND circle, range 5) hits once; its suppression rides the 2-round ground circle.","Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) \u2192 Eye of the Storm or Searing Squall; Burn (01,04,05) \u2192 Eye of the Storm or Razor Crosswind; Fortress (06,07,08) \u2192 Wind at the Back or Smothering Headwind; Suppression (06,09,10) \u2192 Windward Guard or Wind at the Back. Six no-capstone hybrids stay distinct. Strongest unadvertised allocation: 01,02,04,05 (Damage +2, IDG +5%, Afterburn +10%) at 26 row-weighted, one above Burst. All 14 full allocations are non-dominated. Four examples because each capstone closes a different role."],"risks":["Ally hazard: Shroud's Afterburn row is INHERIT on an OTHER_USER circle, friendly fire absent (= ALL): every other user in the circle, allies included, receives it; the caster never does and no ground effect is created (actions.ts 1029-1060; \u00a74b). Searing Squall and Fanning the Flames raise it to 38/45%. Damage is ENEMIES-only and the shield SELF, so only the burn leaks; aim and positioning decide.","Afterburn: Fanning the Flames puts the Shroud debuff at 45% for the two rounds after the cast. Every non-pierce hit a debuffed target takes (kit, normal jutsu, weapons, allies) adds floor(damage \u00d7 45%); Afterburn sources all stack (process.ts 1109-1117) but cumulative Afterburn per hit caps at 60% of the hit, so it saturates. Not a damage instance; downstream value was not simulated.","Classification: Wind is shared with many other bloodlines (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). 5 of 8 kit rows carry Wind; the three element-less rows (Shroud's Decrease Damage Taken and Afterburn, Wind Step's Decrease Damage Given) need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver. Off-kit Wind coverage is unverified.","Increase Damage Given scope: Cutting Tempest's row (Wind, no stat or general filter) applies to Wind hits only; element-less basic attacks and weapons are not matched. Soaring Fujin's row applies to nearly every hit, but it is a hidden NORMAL-type jutsu whose obtainability was not verified; if uncastable, IDG is one row and Wind at the Back is the weakest Foundation.","Delivery: Tempest Shroud's Decrease Damage Taken is a SELF row realized on the caster at cast time (actions.ts 1060-1075; \u00a74b), not positionally; the cast needs any other living user, ally or enemy, within range 4. Wind Step's 2-round ground circle re-applies a one-round Decrease Damage Given each round to enemies on its tiles (process.ts 321-340); one who steps off loses it at that round's end.","Value decisions are user-owned: single-row Decrease Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Given each reach +10% (30 \u2192 40%), Afterburn +10%, Damage +5 on three rows and Increase Damage Given +5%, set by coverage rather than rank on a C-rank bloodline. No combat simulation was performed.","Damage rows are formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling) and multiplied by the Wind passive (bloodline-sourced); Cutting Tempest's buff multiplies later Wind hits by 1.35\u20131.40 only in the two rounds after its cast, so +5 EP is not +5 damage. Both circle Damage rows are ENEMIES-only. Wind Step's move and Soaring Fujin's pool-cost rows are unsupported; mobility is untouched.","Context not modelled: the +10% Fire Increase Damage Taken passive (a standing weakness) is untouched; skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING; normal-tree potency policy is not approved and same-tag potency sources sum at the pin, so a combined audit precedes implementation. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Wind jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Cleaving Cyclone path + Eye of the Storm
Fanning the Flames path + Eye of the Storm
Heart of the Tempest path + Wind at the Back
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE NAMIKAZE KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Draft 4 / Wind classification / forked tree (RUL-2026-10-03-005 wording; values unchanged)
